facts.fact: The UNFPA-commissioned country profile states that there is no civil registration system office or department in Somalia, that the CRVS system needs to be re-established at local, regional and national levels and that infrastructure for it is inadequate, with only some of the 22 municipalities charged with keeping registers and doing so poorly; it names no digital system, and the date is the document's own, taken from its bibliographic citation.

systems.tiers: none: no civil registration office or department at December 2021; no central coordinating authority found by the 2015 assessment

systems.system: municipal civil registers and municipal ID cards
systems.owner: some of the 22 municipalities (local governments), under Law No. 7 of 2003 art. 9.10
systems.tiers: some municipalities maintain registers and issue birth, death and marriage certificates and municipal ID cards; implementation poor; medium not stated

note: The capture is an excerpt, ending within section 5; the sections on current status and challenges were not available to read.
